title: Removes the shipping rate parameter from Create Checkout Session endpoint
summary: Removes the shipping_rates parameter from the Create Checkout Session endpoint. Use the shipping_options parameter instead.
migrationNotes: This simplifies the Checkout Session creation process by providing a single, consolidated way to specify shipping options.

sources.quote: | [Removes the shipping rate parameter from Create Checkout Session endpoint](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2022-08-01/removes-shipping-rate-create-checkout-session.md) | Checkout | Breaking | api |

Removes the `shipping_rates` parameter from the [Create Checkout Session](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2024-06-20) endpoint. Use the `shipping_options` parameter instead.
